items.title: Spirit Airlines Collapsed. What Happens to Budget Travel Now?
items.summary: It's been almost a week since Spirit Airlines shut down. Sarah and Seth still have thoughts on the Skift Travel Podcast.

items.title: Expedia’s B2B Engine Speeds Up as AI Moves Intensify
items.summary: Expedia’s B2B engine is proving the partner model works. The catch: It is still the smaller business, and AI is not yet big enough to change that.

items.title: Brian Chesky Says Airbnb Won’t Mix Homes and Hotels — That’s ‘Pre-AI’ Design
items.summary: Airbnb's Chesky is nothing if not ambitious. Given that people's preferences can change at any moment, the ability to serve customers with only a hotel or home, depending what they need in that instant, seems a long way off, even with agentic AI.

items.title: Sabre Claims Amadeus Blocks Competition in Airline Technology
items.summary: Sabre didn't just report a strong quarter — it used that to publicly pick the biggest fight in airline technology.

items.title: IHG Reports Strong U.S. Demand, a Middle East Hit, and a Bet on AI Content Over Scale
items.summary: IHG is changing how guests search on its own channels. The bigger question is whether its content infrastructure will make it show up when they search everywhere else.

items.title: Trivago Files Antitrust Lawsuit Against Google, Alleges Ongoing Harm
items.summary: Trivago has lobbied against these Google practices for years. Now it's taking the conflict to a German court.

items.title: Tripadvisor Has Made ‘Good Progress’ on Selling TheFork, Explores LLM Data Deals
items.summary: Tripadvisor had a tough first quarter, adversely impacted by cancellations in Mexico, Hawaii, and elsewhere because of the Middle East conflict. Its quest for strategic alternatives has been a multiyear slog.
